analysis.headline: Sharing Practices Unclear
analysis.quote: We prioritize transparent privacy practices by helping our community understand how we collect, use, protect, and share personal information in clear, effective, and accessible ways.

analysis.headline: Minimizes Your Data Collection
analysis.quote: This includes minimizing the amount of personal information we collect to what is necessary, securing user data, and allowing Twitch users to delete their data or opt-out of data collection entirely.

analysis.headline: You Control Your Content
analysis.quote: You can control who interacts with your content, and how it affects your experience on Twitch.

analysis.headline: You Can Opt-Out
analysis.quote: Visit our Privacy Choices page to learn how you can update, delete, disable, access your information, or opt-out of notifications and targeted advertising.

analysis.headline: Privacy Built-In
analysis.quote: Data protection principles are built into Twitch products from the start.
